description: A flat repository with no workspaces: one package at the root, sources under lib/, Vitest specs under spec/, a schema and a template read from disk.

files.spec/upper.spec.ts:
import { expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { upper } from '../lib/strings.js'

it('upper', () => expect(upper('a')).toBe('A'))
files.spec/lower.spec.ts:
import { expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { lower } from '../lib/strings.js'

it('lower', () => expect(lower('A')).toBe('a'))
files.spec/all.spec.ts:
import { expect, it } from 'vitest'
import * as lib from '../lib/index.js'

it('exports', () => expect(Object.keys(lib).length).toBe(2))
files.spec/schema.spec.ts:
import { expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'

it('schema', () => expect(JSON.parse(readFileSync('schema/config.schema.json', 'utf8')).type).toBe('object'))

scenarios.name: a changed name selects its importer and the namespace importer of the barrel, never the sibling
a formatting-only schema change still reaches its schema-policy reader
a template selects its declared reader
a runner configuration change reaches every test of the suite
an unmodeled document falls back to every test, named
